name: A10-0147/2026 – Lukas Mandl – § 15/2
title: REPORT on reinforcing development cooperation to address irregular population movements and their root causes in partner countries
part_text: ‘as well as by providing safer alternatives through the creation of legal channels for safe and regular migration and labour mobility; underlines that strict border control without alternative legal pathways for migration shifts migration routes, introducing different steps into the journey and new transit countries, thus increasing the precariousness of the journey and the exposure of migrants to smuggling networks, extortion and violence’
